snippet.title: KINT: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Kint is an upcoming text-based MMORPG where players decide what lore should be known as the truth.

Want more info? www.kintgame.com

Wishlist us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4524600/Kint/

Follow our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hydroxate/kint-an-online-text-based-fantasy-mmorpg
